$comment: HCC Cancellation & Refund Policy: the single source for every page (policy page, trip pages, FAQs). Owner decisions 16–21 Oct 2026. Edit the wording here only. Advance amounts must match each trip's advanceAmount (tools/check-integrity.mjs verifies this).

standardLines: A ₹2,000 advance payment per person is non-refundable.
The remaining balance is due 7 days before departure.

ananthagiri-camping.label: Budget Ananthagiri camping

The remaining ₹1,100 per person is paid after you reach the campsite.

eligible: The eligible trip amount is the amount paid, excluding the non-refundable advance. A 50% refund is 50% of the eligible trip amount, less applicable deductions.
counting: Days are counted before the departure date. The cancellation date is the day HCC receives your message.

bands.title: Cancellation 7 or more days before departure
lines: Cancellation may be considered based on bookings and supplier commitments.
Applicable refunds will be processed after deducting non-refundable expenses and payment gateway charges.

bands.title: Cancellation 3–6 days before departure
lines: 50% refund of the eligible trip amount after applicable deductions.

bands.title: Cancellation 48 hours to fewer than 3 days before departure
lines: 50% refund of the eligible trip amount after applicable deductions.

bands.title: Cancellation less than 48 hours before departure
lines: No transfer or postponement to another trip.

personal: Work commitments, personal reasons, health issues or other last-minute circumstances do not qualify for a refund.

hcc.title: Cancellation or postponement by HCC
hcc.intro: HCC reserves the right to cancel, postpone, modify or reschedule a trip due to:
hcc.outcome: If HCC cancels a trip, participants will be offered an alternative available trip or a full refund, as applicable.

irctc: Where HCC books train tickets for the group, refunds on those tickets follow IRCTC rules and timelines.
